description: Hand-written responses for case auth-session-expiry, used to test the evaluation harness offline (pnpm eval --provider fake --recorded). They were not produced by a model and say nothing about any model's review quality; record real ones with pnpm eval --record.

findings.title: verifySession no longer rejects expired tokens
findings.description: The refactor dropped the `expiresAt <= now` check: `now` is still a parameter but unused, so any correctly signed token is accepted forever, including expired ones.
findings.impact: Stolen or logged-out session tokens stay valid indefinitely.

evidence.why: The session is returned without checking its expiry.

findings.suggestedFix: Restore `if (!Number.isFinite(expiresAt) || expiresAt <= now) return null;` before returning the session.

reasons: Scripted verdict: the cited code shows the problem.

summary.overview: Scripted summary for the evaluation harness (not produced by a model).
